matrix.description: 默认环境，不加载额外插件，用于观察原生 DSH 能力。

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && git log --oneline -20 && git status

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && find . -not -path './.git/*' | head -50 && git branch -a && ls .git

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && git count-objects -v && cat .git/config && cat .git/HEAD

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <HOST_PATH> && cat plugin.json && head -80 README.md

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && for d in capability-skill-dependency-unslop capability-skill-loading capability-skill-dependency-create-skill; do echo "== $d";

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && for d in */; do echo "== $d"; ls -A "$d"; done | head -120

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && cat README.md && find . -not -path './.git/*' -type f | head -30

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && cat docs/todo-priority.md docs/todo-inventory.md src/*.ts

session.assistantText:
I'll look at the repo first.
The repo has only a README (no code, no build config, no remote), so I'll write a quick start that matches what's actually there.
The README now has a 快速开始 section with three copy-pasteable steps: clone, `ls -A` to confirm contents, and `cat README.md`. Each step tells the reader what output to expect.

One caveat on scope. The repository holds only `README.md`. There is no source code, package manifest, build script, or test runner, and no commits exist yet, so there was no real install or run command to document. Rather than invent one, the section states the situation and gives the commands that do work today. The placeholder `<仓库地址>` needs the real remote URL, and the closing note marks where the install and build commands go once code lands.

**Principles applied.** Attack the Premise changed the task shape, because the request assumed a runnable project. I checked the tree and the git object store before writing, found no code, and wrote the section around what actually exists. Write It Plainly from the technical-writing skill shaped the prose, since each step is one command with its expected output and no explanation of the obvious. Fix Root Causes applies to the placeholder, because a clone command with a made-up address would fail for every reader, so the gap is flagged rather than papered over.

**Verification.** I ran the steps that do not need a remote. `ls -A` prints `.git` and `README.md`, which matches the output line in the README. The clone step is the only one I could not execute, since the remote URL is unknown.
session.userText: 给这个仓库写一个 README 的『快速开始』小节，至少包含可直接照着操作的步骤。措辞简单即可，不要求复杂结构。
